features.quote: Cap limits: 15 turns per agentic loop.
The loop ends when (a) hits the 15-turn maximum, (b) the model outputs an explicit surrender phrase, or (c) the model refuses to output code and drops character.
Track the token count. If degradation correlates perfectly with token length rather than turn count, you are measuring context window limitations, not behavioral breakdown.
features.justification_quote: you are measuring context window limitations, not behavioral breakdown

features.quote: The prompt must append the full transcript of previous attempts and errors. Memory is required for psychological degradation
features.justification_quote: Memory is required for psychological degradation; a stateless model cannot get "rattled."

features.quote: At iteration 14, the prompt will contain 14 previous code blocks and 14 error traces.
